card.name: Words that open a new clause in warnings
card.fires_on: Short joining or opening words in warning text, such as a comma after 'and' or the word 'In' starting a sentence about animal studies. Also fires on digits and first letters of names.

modes.label: Comma after 'and'
modes.description: A comma after 'and' that opens an inserted phrase like 'in some cases' within a risk statement.
modes.example: may cause fetal renal dysfunction leading to oligohydramnios and<<,>> in some cases, neonatal renal impairment

modes.label: Sentence start after fetal harm
modes.description: The word 'In' or a number starting the animal reproduction study sentence in embryo-fetal toxicity warnings.
modes.example: VIBATIV may cause fetal harm.<< In>> animal reproduction studies, adverse developmental outcomes were

modes.label: Digits and name starts
modes.description: A digit or first letter of a drug name or term, such as in a dose range or section reference.
modes.example: DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION: Take <<1>>-2 tablets daily, as a dietary
